title: Adjunct normalization for transported gamma
statement: For fixed Operations, Compositors, OpenComparisons, and CanonicalBridge, the explicitly bridge-transported intrinsic gamma has adjunct equal to the normalized properOpenLambda transpose.

source.place: Core gamma, adjunct, and canonical transport package

proof.text: Transport the intrinsic SemilinearProperOpen.gamma_adjunct equation through the source and target bridge isomorphisms, and identify the resulting mate with properOpenLambda by the definitions of the normalized cartesian, restriction, clopen, and compositor factors.

lean.statement: theorem transportedGamma_adjunct (o : Operations l E) (c : Compositors l E o) (a : OpenComparisons l E o c) (b : CanonicalBridge l E o) : ∀ {U V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : U ⟶ V) (r : U ⟶ W) (p : V ⟶ Z) (i : W ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i] [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i] [IsProper r] [IsProper p] (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) (M : System l E U), (o.extension i).adj.homEquiv _ _ ((transportedGamma l E o b k r p i h).app M) = (properOpenLambda l E o c a k r p i h).inv.app M
